content: I want an angular plate with two quadratic plates positioned in right angel to each other. The edge length of the plates is 140mm. They are 10mm thick. On one of the two plates I would like to have a quadratic cutout, 45x45mm, centred on the plate. | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.name: CreateCode
function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate the positions and dimensions for the plates and cutout\\n\\n# Dimensions for the two quadratic plates\\nedge_length = 140  # mm\\nthickness = 10  # mm\\n\\n# Dimensions for the cutout\\ncutout_size = 45  # mm\\n\\n# Position the first plate along the x-y plane\\nplate1_x = edge_length\\nplate1_y = edge_length\\nplate1_z = thickness\\n\\n# Position the second plate along the y-z plane, rotated 90 degrees\\nplate2_x = thickness\\nplate2_y = edge_length\\nplate2_z = edge_length\\n\\n# Position the cutout centered on the first plate\\ncutout_x = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2\\ncutout_y = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2\\ncutout_z = 0  # On the surface of the first plate\\n\\n# Return the calculated values\\n{\\n    \\\"plate1_x\\\": plate1_x,\\n    \\\"plate1_y\\\": plate1_y,\\n    \\\"plate1_z\\\": plate1_z,\\n    \\\"plate2_x\\\": plate2_x,\\n    \\\"plate2_y\\\": plate2_y,\\n    \\\"plate2_z\\\": plate2_z,\\n    \\\"cutout_x\\\": cutout_x,\\n    \\\"cutout_y\\\": cutout_y,\\n    \\\"cutout_z\\\": cutout_z,\\n    \\\"cutout_size\\\": cutout_size\\n}\"}"

{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the positions and dimensions for the plates and cutout

# Dimensions for the two quadratic plates
edge_length = 140  # mm
thickness = 10  # mm

# Dimensions for the cutout
cutout_size = 45  # mm

# Position the first plate along the x-y plane
plate1_x = edge_length
plate1_y = edge_length
plate1_z = thickness

# Position the second plate along the y-z plane, rotated 90 degrees
plate2_x = thickness
plate2_y = edge_length
plate2_z = edge_length

# Position the cutout centered on the first plate
cutout_x = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2
cutout_y = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2
cutout_z = 0  # On the surface of the first plate

# Return the calculated values
{
    "plate1_x": plate1_x,
    "plate1_y": plate1_y,
    "plate1_z": plate1_z,
    "plate2_x": plate2_x,
    "plate2_y": plate2_y,
    "plate2_z": plate2_z,
    "cutout_x": cutout_x,
    "cutout_y": cutout_y,
    "cutout_z": cutout_z,
    "cutout_size": cutout_size
}"}
